Content: `text(Byte)` pair encoding is a data encoding technique. The encoding algorithm looks for pairs of characters that appear in the string more than `text(once)` and replaces `text(each instance)` of that pair with a corresponding character that does not appear in the string. The algorithm saves a list containing the mapping of character pairs to their corresponding replacement characters.

For example, the string `tttext(“THIS_IS_THE_BEST_WISH”)` can be encoded as `tttext(“%#_#_%E_BEST_W#H”)` by replacing all instances of `tttext(“TH”)` with `tttext(“%”)` and replacing all instances of `tttext(“IS”)` with `tttext(“#”)`.
